purpose: Pack, inspect, and safely unpack a deterministic portable creation bundle whose manifest binds every project-relative file to its exact bytes and SHA-256 digest.

properties.operation: inspect by default, pack, or unpack
properties.source: existing validated project directory for pack
properties.project_type: generic, static-web, or python when packing
properties.name: optional human-readable bundle name
properties.replace: optional boolean for archive or target replacement

relationships: moves verified creation bytes between standalone machines or host adapters without granting execution authority
rejects symlinks, unsafe paths, duplicate entries, undeclared files, and manifest/body digest drift

anatomy_refs.basis: Builds and re-inspects a deterministic ZIP_STORED artifact with an exact canonical manifest.
Provides a generic content packaging route usable by game projects without claiming a complete game-specific release pipeline.

limitations: the format preserves regular project files only; symlinks, executable permission bits, ownership, timestamps, and platform metadata are intentionally excluded
a valid bundle proves archive structure and exact byte identity, not runtime compatibility or semantic correctness
archives are bounded to 1024 files and 128 MiB of body data
packing and unpacking ordinary creations cannot mutate the protected live machine body

truth.basis: The canonical manifest, archive digest, entry bounds, and exact per-file observations remain visible while runtime compatibility stays unclaimed.

agency.basis: The caller chooses the source, archive, target, project type, name, and replacement behavior; inspection grants no execution authority.

continuity.basis: Pack is reproducible, unpack is staged, and target replacement retains rollback until the published body is reverified.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: Unsafe paths, links, compression, undeclared entries, drift, and failed project validation stop before publication.
